subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Mobile Automation Frameworks
description: A quick, practical guide to Mobile Automation Frameworks.

hook.text: A manual tester takes 4 hours to regress 50 mobile tests. Automation runs them in 15 minutes overnight.

buildup.text: Mobile automation frameworks let testers script interactions like taps, swipes, and text input on devices.

discovery.text: Appium works cross-platform. XCUITest is iOS-native. Espresso is Android-native. Each has trade-offs.

twist.text: Cross-platform tools cover both OSes with one script. Native tools are faster and more reliable per platform.

climax.text: A team uses Appium for shared flows and native tools for platform-specific features. Best of both worlds.

punchline.text: Automate the repetitive. Explore the unpredictable. Use the right tool for each.

quiz.question: What is Appium's main advantage?
options: It supports both iOS and Android with one script
